title: Independently review the method-acceptance requirement map and owner request draft of #400 before the Policymaker files it
body:
## Goal
Session #400 (author GPT family, codex gpt-6.1-sol) concluded `decision: request-acceptance-now` and wrote a requirement map and an owner request draft. Its report snapshot is in the repository: .github/loop/data/session-reports/400/0473f3e7b3c710e181ac9926a5673776172725a8cca8a5025221b76f545bfe83.json (field `body`). evaluation.md:58-59 requires an independent check of the method before the owner assesses it. Expected gain: a verified, corrected owner request text that the Policymaker files in this iteration (the Policymaker wakes after you and reads your `verdict:` line and the corrected draft).

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write the marked .session/report.md first (status wip) and update it as you go.
- [ ] Check each row of the #400 requirement map against docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and benchmark/protocol.md: is the cited evidence pinned in benchmark/preparation.json, is the milestone label right in benchmark/preparation-status.json, is the state (`met-for-method`, `resource-blocked`, `owner-decision`) defensible? List each wrong or overstated row with file:line.
- [ ] Name any evaluation.md or protocol.md requirement the map omits, or any `met-for-method` row that is actually `not-met-now-doable`. If one exists, give the smallest task that closes it.
- [ ] Verify each fact of the draft by script: sha256 of benchmark/preparation.json (expected ccff5e0e...), that benchmark/ and docs/ are unchanged between 817dac675c8032bad8820672149874424389d3bd and current main, the numbers quoted from docs/research/0002-delivery.md (89-264 and 33-99 engineer-days, 56-165 difference, 413 of 415 RSRC files) with line numbers, and the same-family review limits against the limitation sentences in preparation-status.json.
- [ ] Check that the draft keeps every gap visible: zero native executions, 23 unresolved native slots, no split allocation, store readiness pending #379 under #268, #169 not ready, missing typedef-impact and diagram-difference development cases, and that it claims no readiness, threshold, goal gate, product claim or fallback choice.
- [ ] One line `verdict: accept` or `verdict: revise`. Then the full corrected draft (title, what, why, unblocks, numbered owner steps) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: sentences of at most 25 words, active voice, one idea per sentence; name current main commit sha.
- [ ] Change no repository file. Do not run git commit or git diff acceptance checks.

## Verification
`python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`

## Context
- .github/loop/data/session-reports/400/0473f3e7b3c710e181ac9926a5673776172725a8cca8a5025221b76f545bfe83.json: the map and draft under review (read with python3 json, print `body` only).
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md, benchmark/protocol.md: requirements.
- benchmark/preparation.json, benchmark/preparation-status.json: pins, labels, limitations (bounded python3 inspection).
- docs/research/0002-delivery.md: lines 95-170 only.

## Budget
At most 25 tool calls and 300k input tokens. Do not open development case JSON files, benchmark/lineage.json or benchmark/results/challenges.json. Do not read .session/report.md in Verification.

title: Write public typedef-impact and diagram-difference development case specifications (review #403 finding, protocol.md:127)
body:
## Goal
Review #403 (verdict revise) found that public specifications for typedef-impact and diagram-difference development cases are `not-met-now-doable` (benchmark/protocol.md:15,18,55,127). Native execution stays blocked on #169, but the specifications can exist now with native answers marked unavailable. Expected gain: the two missing case designs exist and pass a checker, so the method-acceptance request no longer lists them as missing designs. The next Policymaker checks `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/change_cases.py --check` on main and orders one independent review.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write the marked .session/report.md first (status wip) and update it as you go.
- [ ] Create only new files: benchmark/change-cases/README.md, benchmark/change-cases/typedef-impact.spec.json, benchmark/change-cases/diagram-difference.spec.json and benchmark/scripts/change_cases.py. Do not edit any file pinned in benchmark/preparation.json and do not edit preparation.json or preparation-status.json.
- [ ] typedef-impact spec: one original .ctl from the prepared actor-framework source (candidates from #251: Dequeue Priority.ctl, DVR Contents.ctl, Time-Delay Override Options.ctl) with path and sha256; frozen questions; required claim identifiers; consumer candidates found by static reading, marked unconfirmed; a documented edit recipe applied to derived copies only; observation procedure (affected/unaffected consumer checks, native difference evidence, controlled I/O); checker steps; every native answer `unavailable` with reason #169.
- [ ] diagram-difference spec: one original VI with path and sha256; two derived-copy edit recipes, one behavior-changing and one presentation-only, plus an uncertain-effect category; frozen questions and claim identifiers; observation and checker steps; native answers `unavailable` (#169). State that no paired public revisions exist (actor-framework checkout has one commit).
- [ ] Both specs record that edits and builds need an explicit owner grant before execution (protocol.md:120) and that semantic documentation must be pinned by version, location and content hash (protocol.md:59); list the documentation still unpinned as a gap.
- [ ] change_cases.py --check (stdlib only) validates required fields, frozen claim ids, `unavailable` native answers and grant flags; it verifies source sha256 only when LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT is set and otherwise prints that the check was skipped; it has at least 4 in-memory rejecting mutations with asserted reasons. Write no __pycache__.
- [ ] README states: design only, zero native executions, no key established, no edit performed.
- [ ] Do not run git commit or git diff checks.

## Verification
`python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/change_cases.py --check`

## Context
- benchmark/protocol.md lines 12-20, 45-63, 115-127: task families, oracle procedures, resources.
- benchmark/cases/dev/README.md: existing development case conventions (read only).
- Prepared sources under LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT (actor-framework): read only the chosen .ctl/.vi metadata and bounded byte searches.

## Budget
At most 30 tool calls and 350k input tokens. Do not open development case JSON files, benchmark/lineage.json or benchmark/results/challenges.json. Write the report early and keep it current.

title: Write the development repetition, precision and model-quota plan for the baseline (review #403 finding, protocol.md:90)
body:
## Goal
Review #403 found that benchmark/protocol.md:90 still lists a concrete model/provider quota and a repetition/precision plan as missing, and the method map omitted them. Expected gain: a design-only plan that closes the repetition/precision item and states the quota item as an exact owner decision. The next Policymaker checks `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/precision_plan.py --check` on main and orders one independent review.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write the marked .session/report.md first (status wip) and update it as you go.
- [ ] Create only new files: benchmark/precision/README.md, benchmark/precision/plan.json and benchmark/scripts/precision_plan.py. Do not edit any file pinned in benchmark/preparation.json.
- [ ] plan.json: repetitions per case and arm, paired-difference uncertainty procedure at project/lineage level (confidence level, resampling seed and count, missing-pair treatment) per protocol.md:88, per-dimension tolerances left to case oracles, and a pilot rule that sizes repetitions from development-only variance before any evaluation run. Fields must match names in benchmark/baseline/run-manifest.template.json where they overlap; list each match.
- [ ] Quota section: candidate provider/model routes from the loop routing (claude-sonnet-5-5, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-5.6-luna), image-support need, pinning limits, and the exact owner decision needed (which existing subscription quota to allocate; no extra spending). Mark quota `owner-decision`.
- [ ] precision_plan.py --check (stdlib) validates the plan and cross-checks the manifest field names, with at least 3 in-memory rejecting mutations with asserted reasons; no environment needed; write no __pycache__.
- [ ] README states: design only, no run executed, no threshold proposed.
- [ ] Do not run git commit or git diff checks.

## Verification
`python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/precision_plan.py --check`

## Context
- benchmark/protocol.md lines 77-90: baseline requirements.
- benchmark/baseline/run-manifest.template.json, benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md: existing field names (read only).

## Budget
At most 25 tool calls and 300k input tokens. Do not open development case JSON files, benchmark/lineage.json or benchmark/results/challenges.json.
